name: How long does a typical modern landscape design project take from concept to completion?
description: Project timelines vary; smaller designs might take 4-8 weeks, while larger projects can take 3-6 months or more, depending on scope and permits.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical modern landscape design project take from concept to completion?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a modern landscape design project varies significantly based on complexity and scope. Smaller projects, such as a patio renovation, might take 4-8 weeks for design and construction. Larger, more intricate designs involving extensive hardscaping, custom features, and significant planting can span 3-6 months or even longer. Factors influencing duration include permit approvals, material lead times, and weather conditions. A detailed project schedule is provided after the initial design phase.
